title: COME & LIVE IN PORT AUGUSTA
tickerText: PORT AUGUSTA IS WHERE OPPORTUNITY MEETS ADVENTURE. POSITIONED AT THE TOP OF THE SPENCER GULF AND ON THE DOORSTEP OF THE ICONIC FLINDERS RANGES, OUR CITY OFFERS A LIFESTYLE THAT’S AS INSPIRING AS IT IS ACCESSIBLE. WITH STRONG TRANSPORT LINKS, GROWING INDUSTRIES, AND A WELCOMING, CONNECTED COMMUNITY, PORT AUGUSTA IS A PLACE TO LIVE, WORK, AND GROW. FROM BREATHTAKING NATURAL LANDSCAPES TO A VIBRANT CULTURAL SCENE AND RELAXED, SPACIOUS LIVING, EVERY DAY HERE IS AN INVITATION TO EXPLORE, ENJOY, AND BELONG.
